items.title: Cookie Monsters
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description: These monsters are tasty, crunchy and chocolatey! It's not every day that creepy and scary monsters are this delicious! Which cookie monster will you roleplay as and scare people with!

items.title: Missing Parts
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description: These teens are ghastly and creepy! Each one is missing something and it ain't pretty! This Halloween roleplay as a ghoulish teen and haunt your friends.

items.title: Sinister Souls
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description: Sinister souls lurk in the shadow, under your bed, in your worst nightmares. Look epic and ghastly with these skins! Perfect for roleplaying and a perfect Halloween costume this year!

items.title: Better Swamps
items.creator: Yeggs
items.description:
Ever wanted to befriend some frogs, ride a crocodile, and explore a giant tree? Have a new adventure in this update to the classic Swamp biome in Minecraft! Explore dungeons, fight off new enemies, and drive the hoverboat!

- 1+ players
- Hoverboat
- Crocodiles and frogs!
- Swamp Creature, dragonflies, and more
- New items and foods
- Lots of custom structures

items.title: Luxury Teens
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description: Luxury teen skins bring modern styles into your favorite world! Enjoy fashionable trends that will never go out of style!

items.title: Iconic Teens
items.creator: Cypress Games
items.description:
Are you ready to have the most iconic skins ever!? If so, here is the Iconic Teens pack! Everyone will admire your cuteness and they won't be able to take their eyes off you!

+ 10 skins
+ 1 free skin
+ Perfect for roleplay

items.title: Kawaii Fashion
items.creator: Cypress Games
items.description:
The cutest and coolest skins ever are here! If you are an kawaii lover, you will love these skins! Suit up and create the cutest team!

+ 10 kawaii themed skins
+ 1 free skin
+ Perfect for roleplay

items.title: Space Party
items.creator: Sapphire Studios
items.description:
There’s a party in the galaxy next door and you’re invited! Join these teens and aliens for a groovy night of fun and games.
Pick your favorite outfit and come on over for the biggest space party!

items.title: LUCKY BLOCKS RAINBOW!
items.creator: Chunklabs
items.description:
What is better than the standard yellow block with random outcomes you know and love? Rainbow lucky blocks! Get super amazing loot, dangerous traps or a cool bouncy castle. From flocks of animals to clocks or diamonds, you never know what is in them!

+ Upgraded lucky blocks
+ Super pickaxe and super sword obtainable
+ Craft or find them throughout the world

items.title: Camo Blocks: Ninjas
items.creator: Magefall
items.description:
These ninjas are perfectly camouflaged with nature! Hide from your friends and stealth around in plain sight!

- 8 camo block skins!
- Includes: Grass, tree, stone, cactus, lava, water, mossy cobblestone, and sand!
- Roleplay as your favourite Minecraft blocks!

items.title: Block Party
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description:
These blocky designs are colorful, cute and cool! Which pattern will you choose today? There are some familiar faces here too! A panda, a dirt block and even a slime!

- 16 skins

items.title: Galaxy Skulls
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description:
These galaxy skulls live on the stars and come from deep dark space! They glow and sparkle with galactic colors never seen before. These galaxy skins are great for roleplaying and matching with your friends.

- 11 skins

items.title: Mob Minis
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description:
These mini mobs are so cool and not to mention cute! Run around as a miniature adorable mob. In this skin pack you can be a mini Warden or even a mini Guardian! So many tiny monsters to choose from.

- 11 skins

items.title: Next Level Skyblock
items.creator: Mine-North
items.description:
Next Level Skyblock brings your skyblock experience to the next level. conquer mini-dungeons and previously undiscovered islands alone or with your friends.

+ 6 skins
+ 1 free skin
+ Dungeons
+ Nether

Created by Mine-North

items.title: Cats
items.creator: Mine-North
items.description:
Play your own cat with your friends and enjoy.

+ 10 different cats
+ 2 free skin

Created by Mine-North

items.title: Basketball Players
items.creator: Mine-North
items.description:
Do you want to be a famous basketball player? Do you want to impress your friends on the field? Play as your favorite star. And find yourself in the match of your life.

+ 10 different skins
+ Basketball
+ Famous player
+ 1 free skin

Created by Mine-North

items.title: Going Medieval
items.creator: Shaliquinn's Schematics
items.description: Take a trip back in time with the newest release from Shaliquinn's Schematics! On a faraway coastline lies a city time has long forgotten. Trapped years in the past, it has remained unchanged by technology or society. Venture deep within its borders to discover secrets lost to the ages and claim this kingdom for yourself!

items.title: Ship Ahoy
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Set sail and get to the cannons, seaman! We must win this battle!

- 2 large fleets of ships
- Giant octopus
- Exciting underwater world with many shipwrecks and an ocean monument nearby!
- Can you find all the hidden treasure chests?
- By Team Ethyria

items.title: The Sultan's Oasis
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Will you stroll through the narrow alleyways of an exotic city or will you explore the Sultan’s palace? Rest up and unwind in the lush greenery of the oasis before setting out for new desert adventures! 

- City and palace survival spawn
- By RareLoot

items.title: Roman City
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Start your adventure in this beautiful roman city, collect coins, trade with villagers, and hunt for treasures. Find the mysterious key to open the great gate. Explore the whole city now.

- Collectable coins to trade with villagers
- 1 Mini-Quest to open the palace gate
- Secret chests and treasures
- By Eternal Creations

items.title: Life in the CountrySide
items.creator: Box Build
items.description:
Why not live on a farm? Here you can start your world of survival and explore as much as you can! Enjoy it!

- 6 barns with initial items!
- Animals: cow, pig, chicken, horse, bees, llamas, turtles
- Crops: beetroot, carrots, wheats, pumpkin, melon, potato, sweet berries, honey farm and much more!

Created by Stallyun Creations and Published by Kuboc Studios.

items.title: Anime Mansion
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Behold the spooky and magnificent Anime Mansion. Home of the darkest and scariest secrets, hidden behind the walls and the gardens of the architectural beauty of the mansion. Do you dare to explore the palace with everything you have got?

- Stunning survival spawn
- By RareLoot

items.title: Noob Pro God Houses
items.creator: In Mine
items.description:
It's time to choose a new house. Who are you? Noob kid, pro survivalist man or maybe someone old and more powerful? Make choices, find secrets, and go to the journey!

- 3 really different houses
- 3 cool skins for roleplay
- Supports multiplayer with friends

items.title: Millionaire Valley
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Move into this GIANT Mansion and live your life as best as possible! Explore the areas and have fun!

+ Giant beautiful mansion!
+ Many unique rooms!

- By Orbital Studios and 4KS Studios
